title: Installer preflight: verify offline bundle signature + manifest integrity (fail closed)
creator: Talia Benson
description:
Context
Air-gapped customers need an offline install/upgrade workflow that verifies Redwood provenance without reaching any network services. This ticket implements verification in the installer preflight step and ensures the installer fails closed on signature/manifest mismatch.

We are targeting Redwood Private offline bundles (VPC + on-prem packaging) and piggybacking on the existing bundle/installer architecture.

Goals
- Add signature verification to installer preflight for offline bundles.
- Enforce integrity of the manifest and all referenced artifacts via hashes in the signed manifest.
- Fail closed by default: block install/upgrade when verification fails or when signing key is untrusted.
- Provide a consistent error taxonomy (stable codes + actionable messages) so Support/SE can triage.
- Provide a clear, policy-gated break-glass path (implemented in follow-up ticket/PR) but ensure it is auditable and noisy.

Non-goals
- Customer-signed bundles / delegation (explicitly deferred; see PM + Security notes).
- Replacing the whole packaging mechanism.
- Online verification / transparency log requirements in the initial phase.

References
- Confluence design: offline-signing-and-verification-design (eng-private-deployments/onprem-packaging)
- Confluence bundle spec: offline-bundle-format-and-manifest (eng-private-deployments/onprem-packaging)
- ADR: adr-0147-offline-artifact-signing-scheme
- Threat model: threat-model-offline-bundle-signing

Implementation plan
1) Preflight entrypoint
- Add/extend preflight command to require a bundle path when --airgapped is set.
- Preflight performs:
  a) Bundle layout checks (required files present)
  b) Manifest parsing + canonicalization verification (as defined in ENG-4821)
  c) Signature verification against local trust store (ENG-4825)
  d) Artifact integrity verification: compute SHA-256 over each referenced file and compare to manifest
  e) Optional checks: time validity window handling and time-skew guidance (no network calls)

2) Fail-closed semantics
- Default behavior: verification failure is fatal and blocks install/upgrade.
- Migration path: if an explicit flag exists for legacy unsigned bundles, it must be:
  - off by default
  - require explicit acknowledgement in CLI output
  - emit an audit warning event locally
  - documented as temporary (sunset date tracked in PM ticket)

3) Error taxonomy
- Provide stable error codes (string) + remediation text.
- Errors must:
  - identify WHAT failed (signature vs manifest vs artifact)
  - include the exact file path(s) involved
  - recommend next step (re-download bundle, verify transfer, update trust store, check time source)
  - avoid leaking sensitive host details (no env dumps by default)

Proposed error codes (v1)
Verification failures should map to one of these codes, returned consistently from preflight and logged to installer logs:
- RI-PRE-VER-001: BUNDLE_NOT_FOUND (bundle path does not exist)
- RI-PRE-VER-002: BUNDLE_LAYOUT_INVALID (missing required files: manifest/signature/artifacts dir)
- RI-PRE-VER-010: MANIFEST_PARSE_ERROR (invalid JSON/YAML; include offset if available)
- RI-PRE-VER-011: MANIFEST_CANONICALIZATION_MISMATCH (manifest is not in canonical form expected for signing)
- RI-PRE-VER-020: SIGNATURE_FILE_MISSING (detached signature expected but not found)
- RI-PRE-VER-021: SIGNATURE_INVALID (signature verification failed)
- RI-PRE-VER-022: SIGNING_KEY_UNTRUSTED (key id not in trust store)
- RI-PRE-VER-023: SIGNATURE_EXPIRED (signature/cert validity window exceeded, if applicable)
- RI-PRE-VER-024: SIGNATURE_NOT_YET_VALID (system time earlier than validity start)
- RI-PRE-VER-030: ARTIFACT_HASH_MISMATCH (computed hash != manifest hash)
- RI-PRE-VER-031: ARTIFACT_MISSING (manifest references an artifact not present in bundle)
- RI-PRE-VER-032: MANIFEST_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED (manifest schema version not supported by this installer)
- RI-PRE-VER-040: DOWNGRADE_BLOCKED (signed version lower than installed state; implemented in ENG-24902 follow-up)
- RI-PRE-VER-050: BREAK_GLASS_REQUIRED (user attempted an unsafe operation without required policy flag; follow-up ticket)

CLI/UX requirements
- Preflight prints a concise summary:
  - Bundle build id / version from manifest
  - Signing key id (kid) used
  - Verification result: VERIFIED / FAILED
  - If failed: one primary error code + one-line remediation
  - Pointer to log file location
- Avoid dumping full manifest by default (support diagnostics can use inspect command from ENG-4826).

Telemetry / audit (local)
- Preflight should emit a local audit event for:
  - verify.success
  - verify.failure (include error code)
  - verify.break_glass_used (future; must include operator justification)

Acceptance criteria
- [x] Installer preflight verifies signature against trust store and blocks install on failure.
- [x] Installer preflight verifies artifact hashes from signed manifest and blocks install on mismatch.
- [x] Verification does not require any network access and does not attempt downloads in air-gapped mode.
- [x] Error taxonomy is implemented with stable codes; Support can map codes to runbooks.
- [x] Tests cover tampering scenarios (at least: modified manifest, swapped artifact, missing signature, unknown key).
- [x] Output messaging is actionable and points to remediation.

Notes / open questions
- Validity windows and time skew: we need to be careful about certificates/notBefore in air-gapped environments; follow-ups tracked under time-skew bugfix work.
- How strict to be during migration for existing customers with unsigned bundles: strict-by-default agreed; break-glass is documented and auditable (separate ticket).
comments: 2025-11-19 (Talia Benson): Created as part of Phase 1 deliverables. Please align error codes with Support/Docs so we don’t end up with per-team naming. Target is pilot readiness by mid-Jan.

2025-11-22 (Ethan Park): Initial implementation plan drafted. Starting with detached signature layout (manifest.json + manifest.sig) per ADR-0147. Will keep errors stable (RI-PRE-VER-xxx) and reuse across install/upgrade paths.

2025-11-27 (Marcus Lin): Security review notes: fail-closed must be the default; any override must be explicit, logged, and hard to automate silently. Also make sure we verify canonicalization before signature verification to prevent “same data different bytes” ambiguity.
2025-12-03 (Ethan Park): Implemented verification plumbing in preflight behind --airgapped. Pending trust store wiring (ENG-4825) and error taxonomy cleanup. Local log path now printed on failure.

2025-12-09 (Dev Patel): Support request: error codes need to include file name(s) and a single clear remediation step. For hash mismatch, explicitly call out common causes (bad unzip tooling, line-ending corruption, partial transfer) and recommend re-transfer with checksum verification.
2025-12-14 (Ethan Park): Added structured error mapping layer so install/upgrade can share codes. Next: integration tests for tamper cases; coordinating with ENG-4827 owner.

2026-01-06 (Connor O'Brien): Release gating note: we will block cutting Private release artifacts if preflight verification tests don’t pass on the RC bundle. Please ensure tests can run in CI within reasonable time.

2026-01-10 (Ethan Park): Merged primary preflight verification implementation. Follow-ups for improved messaging + break-glass flag tracked separately. Confirmed no outbound calls in --airgapped path.

2026-02-07 (Ethan Park): Closed after pilot validation. Verified common failures map cleanly to codes and runbooks. Time-skew UX improved in subsequent patch PR; break-glass audit markers landed in dedicated ticket.
test_plan: Unit tests: canonicalization verification and signature verification API wrapper (good signature / bad signature / missing sig).
Unit tests: artifact hashing over various file sizes; ensure constant-time compare for hashes where practical.
Integration tests (CI): create a minimal test bundle fixture, sign with test key, run installer preflight in --airgapped mode and assert VERIFIED output.
Integration tests: tamper manifest.json (single byte) -> expect RI-PRE-VER-021 or RI-PRE-VER-011 (depending on canonicalization path).
Integration tests: swap one artifact file -> expect RI-PRE-VER-030 with file path printed.
Integration tests: remove manifest.sig -> expect RI-PRE-VER-020.
Integration tests: sign with unknown key -> expect RI-PRE-VER-022 and guidance to update trust store.
Integration tests: missing artifact referenced by manifest -> expect RI-PRE-VER-031.
Negative test: ensure no network access attempted in air-gapped mode (mock network layer, assert no calls).
Performance sanity: preflight runtime on representative pilot bundle sizes; ensure progress output (or at least “verifying …”) to avoid perceived hangs.
